questions.q: What does Nebraska law say about riding a motorcycle between lanes of traffic?
options: Riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed
Only lane filtering is allowed, when traffic is stopped or slow
questions.explanation: Nebraska: riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed.

questions.q: In Nebraska, what is the youngest age for a motorcycle learner's permit?
questions.explanation: Nebraska issues a motorcycle permit at 15 years at the earliest.
questions.remember: Nebraska motorcycle permit: 15 years at the earliest.
